newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 4.8 billion yuan from 3.75 billion on Tuesday and the most active one was the 20-day contract.
Traders said the most active buyers were still the non-banking financial institutions encouraged by active trading in the A share markets.
Two new A share issues on Thursday in Shanghai and Shenzhen also helped make trading active, traders said.
But expectations of a cut in bank interest rates continued to prevail on the market, preventing the rates from rising further in the mid-term, one local trader said.
